findings.issue: pkill -f with patterns present in its own command line killed the agent's shell three-plus times (exit 143) and, at turn 49, also killed the API server (api/server.mjs matches 'server.mjs'), producing a misleading ECONNREFUSED detour
findings.suggestion: Use a pidfile, fuser -k <port>/tcp, or pattern constructions that can't match the running shell's cmdline; never reuse a broad pkill pattern after it self-kills once

findings.issue: Debugged a suspected hydration/[selected] bug for ~8 turns while the dev server was stale (old JS chunk 404ing) because the /proc/$p/cmdline grep-based kill silently failed (NUL-separated cmdline, no `grep -a`), leaving pid 853 alive
findings.suggestion: After every rebuild, confirm the server actually restarted (check listening pid / EADDRINUSE in the log) before debugging client behavior; verify kill success with pgrep

findings.issue: allowedHosts: ['*'] disables Angular's SSRF host validation (the server logs a security warning on every start)
findings.suggestion: Defensible given the reverse-proxy requirement and the comment explaining it, but consider deriving allowed hosts from PORT/known hostnames instead of '*'

findings.issue: agent-browser 'set viewport 412 800' did not apply; mobile screenshots came out 1280px and were nearly compared against the wrong reference
findings.suggestion: Use the Playwright API directly for viewport-specific screenshots, or verify viewport with an eval before trusting the capture

findings.issue: Spent 2-3 turns trying to crop a PNG (PIL/ImageMagick/sharp not available) to read table columns, then abandoned and reasoned from the full-size image anyway
findings.suggestion: The screenshot's readable columns weren't load-bearing; skipping the crop immediately would have saved the turns

summary: A disciplined, front-loaded session: the agent read the spec, tests, data shapes and reference screenshots before writing, made the right architecture calls (request-time SSR, no build-time data), and landed 53/54 tests on its first run with only one real fix cycle. Verification was exemplary — full suite after the final edit plus visual comparison of every page at both widths. The main blemish is bash process management: repeated pkill self-kills and a stale dev server that cost roughly 12-15 turns of avoidable debugging.
